import Mathlib
open Filter Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem Munkres_exercise_23_2 {X : Type*}
  [TopologicalSpace X] {A : ℕ → Set X} (hA : ∀ n, IsConnected (A n))
  (hAn : ∀ n, A n ∩ A (n + 1) ≠ ∅) :
  IsConnected (⋃ n, A n) := by
  have h_union : ∀ n, IsConnected (⋃ k ≤ n, A k) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      refine (show (⋃ k ≤ 0, A k) = A 0 by
          ext x
          constructor
          · intro hx
            obtain ⟨k, hk, hx'⟩ := mem_iUnion₂.mp hx
            rwa [Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hk] at hx'
          · intro hx
            exact mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨0, le_rfl, hx⟩) ▸ hA 0
    | succ n ih =>
      refine (show (⋃ k ≤ n.succ, A k) = (⋃ k ≤ n, A k) ∪ A n.succ by
          ext x
          constructor
          · intro hx
            obtain ⟨k, hk, hx'⟩ := mem_iUnion₂.mp hx
            rcases Nat.le_succ_iff.mp hk with h | rfl
            · exact Or.inl (mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨k, h, hx'⟩)
            · exact Or.inr hx'
          · rintro (hx | hx)
            · obtain ⟨k, hk, hx'⟩ := mem_iUnion₂.mp hx
              exact mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨k, Nat.le_succ_of_le hk, hx'⟩
            · exact mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨n.succ, le_rfl, hx⟩) ▸ ?_
      refine IsConnected.union ?_ ih (hA n.succ)
      refine Nonempty.mono ?_ (nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr (hAn n))
      intro x hx
      exact ⟨mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨n, le_rfl, hx.1⟩, hx.2⟩
  refine ⟨?ne, ?pre⟩
  · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (hA 0).nonempty
    exact ⟨x, mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨0, hx⟩⟩
  · intro u v hu hv hcover huNe hvNe
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxu⟩ := huNe
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyv⟩ := hvNe
    obtain ⟨n, hxn⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hx
    obtain ⟨m, hym⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hy
    set k := max n m
    have hxS : x ∈ ⋃ i ≤ k, A i := mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨n, le_max_left n m, hxn⟩
    have hyS : y ∈ ⋃ i ≤ k, A i := mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨m, le_max_right n m, hym⟩
    have hsub : (⋃ i ≤ k, A i) ⊆ ⋃ i, A i := by
      intro z hz
      obtain ⟨i, _, hzi⟩ := mem_iUnion₂.mp hz
      exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, hzi⟩
    refine Nonempty.mono ?_ ((h_union k).isPreconnected u v hu hv (hsub.trans hcover)
        ⟨x, hxS, hxu⟩ ⟨y, hyS, hyv⟩)
    intro z hz
    simp only [mem_inter_iff] at hz ⊢
    exact ⟨hsub (by tauto), by tauto⟩
